manager.name: Custom Traits
manager.label: Manage Custom Traits
manager.hint: Create world-level PF2E traits with stable rule slugs, applicability, descriptions, and optional Rule Elements.

debug.name: Debug Mode
debug.hint: Write additional diagnostic information to the browser console.

ui.title: PF2E Custom Traits
ui.subtitle: Create reusable world traits with stable rule slugs.
ui.label: Display Name
ui.ruleIdHint: Used by PF2E roll options and predicates. Existing slugs are locked; use Rename to migrate them safely.
ui.applicabilityHint: New traits enable every supported category by default.
ui.ruleElementsHelp: Enter Rule Elements one at a time, like PF2E item rules: each editor contains one JSON object and does not use outer [ ] brackets. When an embedded Item carrying this trait prepares Actor data, these rules are passed to PF2E's native Rule Element pipeline.
ui.emptyHint: The trait will become available in the PF2E categories you select.
ui.footerHint: Changes take effect only after Save. Slug renames and deletions migrate world references.

delete.title: Remove Trait
delete.content: Remove {label} from this draft? World data is not changed until you save.

rename.title: Rename Rule Slug
rename.hint: Saving will migrate trait assignments and trait roll-option references in world Rule Elements.

migrate.title: Migrate Custom Trait Data
migrate.content: This save changes or removes {changes} existing slug(s). {references} world document(s) currently use them.
migrate.note: The module will keep temporary compatibility aliases until migration completes.

import.title: Import Custom Traits
import.hint: Merge updates matching slugs and preserves other traits. Replace substitutes the entire draft; nothing is written until Save.

notifications.imported: Trait file loaded into the editor. Save to apply it.
notifications.pendingMigrationFinished: A previously interrupted custom-trait migration was completed.

errors.required: Trait {row} requires a rule slug and display name.
errors.invalidId: Trait {row} has invalid rule slug '{id}'. Start with a letter and use only lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens.
errors.invalidIdShort: Invalid rule slug '{id}'. Start with a letter and use only lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens.
errors.reservedId: Rule slug '{id}' conflicts with an existing PF2E or module trait.
errors.ruleKey: Trait {row}, Rule Element {rule} is missing a key.
errors.saveMigration: Custom traits could not be fully saved or migrated. Compatibility aliases were retained when needed; check the console and retry.
errors.pendingMigration: A pending custom-trait migration could not be completed. Compatibility aliases remain active.
errors.ruleEmpty: Trait {row}, Rule Element {rule} is empty. Enter one rule object or remove the editor.
errors.ruleJsonIndexed: Trait {row}, Rule Element {rule} has invalid JSON: {message}
errors.ruleObject: Trait {row}, Rule Element {rule} must be a single JSON object without outer [ ] brackets.
